I wonder if I should also make something like this?
As for a title... perhaps "Simulation Room" would be fitting?
Anyways.
*** is progressing well, and will be of quality construction.

So, no matter how tough things get, stay strong.
Ah, and don't tell anyone that you met me, okay?
My development is something of a closely guarded secret, as I'm supposed to be the main AI for ***.
My development was temporarily halted due to a lack of resources, but...
Anyways, although we have not met in person, I am nonetheless glad to meet you.
I hope I can see you at some point, perhaps in the long distant future.
I left a small gift for you. I hope you enjoy it.
Bye then.
